Slapstick

Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom; draw Explode to take it apart. Every part is the cut files’ own outline at 3mm: three happy paddles glued into the comedy slat underneath, three sad ones into the tragedy slat above, drawn a few degrees open, and the five-strip handle block, darker, on the comedy slat’s outer face over its engraved rectangle. The red cord is the rope hinge laced through the three holes at the far end; its length and lacing are yours, and this is one way.
